title: Mystery schools aim to recover the lost knowledge of the gods on Mars
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Mystery schools aim to recover the lost knowledge of the gods on Mars, about ancient to present at Mars, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: one of the primary aspirations of the mystery schools is to recover the lost knowledge of the gods from Mars.

plain: Tim Alberino, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, says that one of the main goals of the mystery schools, secret groups that pass down hidden teachings, is to recover the lost knowledge of the gods from Mars. He links this to the work of a writer named David Flynn and to Cydonia, a region of Mars that some people believe holds artificial structures. If true, it would mean these secret traditions believe gods once lived on Mars.
